blind_read: The monkey's eyes shut and its weight sinks onto its hooked cane as the battery empties.

evidence.observation: The upright head clears the battery, the hand wraps the cane handle, and the tail curves behind the body.

As the body leans right the battery overlaps the brow and scalp. The floor-level tail tip has exposed background inside its outline near (22–25,51). The cane foot now stays on one baseline and its earlier cyan strip is gone.
Finger creases and interior ear shading turn teal. A red pixel appears on the dangling fingers even in the brown drawing.

blockers: The battery cuts into the head in the lean. The flattened tail tip is hollow, and the fixed skin colors contain stray coat and alert colors.
